hostname.description: IP address or hostname of the iLO2 management interface.

password.description: iLO2 password for the login user. In production, consider omitting and using environment variables or external credential stores.

port.description: TCP port for the iLO2 HTTPS service. Typically 443.

login_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for iLO2 login connection to complete.

command_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a fencing command (e.g., off/on/reboot) to complete.

power_wait.description: Seconds to wait between power state changes before retrying. Helps avoid race conditions.

devices.description: Additional iLO2 devices for multi-node clusters. Each entry defines a separate fenced target.

name.description: Logical name for the device (used in logs and cluster tools).

hostname.description: IP address or hostname of the iLO2 interface.

password.description: iLO2 password for this device. Secure in production.
